rules.help: Rules: Final wording replaces the full source and skips later conversion; Protect keeps the source unchanged. Pre-replacements enter OpenCC; post-replacements run after punctuation. Matches are selected from left to right; scope and priority are compared only among candidates at the same start. The Test tab lists overlapping candidates skipped by an earlier match or protection span. Regex uses the bundled VERSION1 dialect, is limited to each extracted text or allowed attribute, and never crosses tags. Disabled rules are marked in the list. Built-in author-credit protection covers common ◎著 forms. Test rules on the Test tab.
